phases.title: Launch the Land Hunt
activities: Set up saved searches on LandWatch, AcreValue, Land.com, Zillow
Lock in your shortlist of counties (eastern OK primary)
Make intro calls to 1 rural agent per target county
Run GIS deep-dive: pull 20-40 parcel candidates
phases.gate: If fewer than 5 candidates by end of Q1, expand to Texas Plan B

phases.title: Walk Properties and Make Offers
activities: Visit 8-12 parcels in person (walk the land, not just drive by)
Score each parcel with the evaluation scorecard
Make offers on 3-5 parcels (10-15% below asking)
Start due diligence on accepted offer
phases.deliverable: One parcel under contract with due diligence started
phases.gate: If no accepted offer by end of Q2, revisit criteria or expand counties

phases.title: Close + Drill Well + Set Up Base
activities: Close on the land — sign, record, take possession
Same-day: get farm number from FSA + file ag exemption
Same-day: visit NRCS office, introduce yourself, ask about EQIP
Week 1: hire consulting forester, schedule timber cruise
Schedule well drilling (60-90 day lead time)
Set up travel trailer on property — temporary base camp
Begin perimeter fence (learn on the job)
Submit EQIP application once management plan is ready
phases.deliverable: Land owned, well scheduled, forester hired, EQIP submitted, living on site
phases.gate: Water yield confirmed? If well comes in under 3 GPM, activate backup cistern plan

phases.title: Water + Foundation + First Trees
activities: Well drilling complete — test water quality
Site prep: driveway, building pad, drainage
Root cellar / storm shelter dug and poured
Plant Year 1 trees (60 bare-root — pecan, walnut, persimmon, mulberry)
phases.deliverable: Water flowing, septic done, foundation ready, trees in ground, fence complete
phases.gate: Budget check — if cumulative spend exceeds $130K, defer Y1 trees batch 2

phases.title: Shell Goes Up
activities: Crew erects columns + trusses (1-day safety hire)
Building is now 'dried in' — protected from rain
phases.deliverable: Shell standing, dried in, ready for interior work
phases.gate: Shell on budget? Any structural surprises?

phases.title: Insulation + Rough Systems
phases.deliverable: Insulated envelope, all rough systems in place
phases.gate: If cumulative spend exceeds $215K, defer battery to Y2

phases.title: Solar + Interior Finish
activities: Solar panels + battery installed (DIY + licensed tie-in)
phases.deliverable: House is livable — power, water, climate control, finished interior
phases.gate: If cumulative spend exceeds $245K, defer aquaponics to Y3

phases.title: Move In
activities: Move family from trailer into house
phases.deliverable: Family living in the house. Trailer retired. Homestead operational.
phases.gate: Year 1 review — budget, schedule, family sentiment all green?

phases.title: Food Systems Come Online
activities: Aquaponics system built, cycled, first fish stocked
Hair sheep flock (8-10 head) + livestock guardian dog
Rotational grazing fence installed (EQIP may reimburse)
phases.gate: Ag exemption documented. Food self-sufficiency measured.

phases.title: Scale, Optimize, First Legacy Yields
activities: Aquaponics scaled to full production (~200 lbs fish/year)
Pond construction (EQIP cost-share — ~$650 out of pocket)
Livestock numbers stable, rotational grazing dialed in
Possible compound expansion if other families are ready
phases.deliverable: Homestead is self-sustaining. Mike can leave for 2 weeks without crisis.
phases.gate: Daughters at decision points. Compound option evaluated.
